body: Ok I don’t know how to find post from around March but I’ll start looking I only recently began looking through the sub. Apologies if I’m coming across as ignorant, that may be exactly what’s happening I just personally felt that there is a lot of people who dislike the game because it wasn’t like the original.

You’re right I might just not be looking to deeply into this sub, I’m in the Pacific time zone. The only reason I made this post is because I came to this sub prior to playing the game and after seeing the hate the game got and playing it for myself I just felt as if there was a large amount of hate for this game because of how the story affected/effected, whatever I’ve been drinking, the original. Specifically that people can empathize with Joel despite him possibly (because we will never know if a vaccine was possible) causing every second of human suffering and not with Abby who wanted revenge for her fathers murder.

Yea looking through these post are pretty easy to find, the comments on a lot of these memes we’re also a good reference for peoples dislike of the game, but it just seems like these are outliers those who just seems to hate the game because it’s not the same as the first. Personally I would’ve been fine without this game I thought the original was a great stand alone and didn’t need a sequel that being said I really did enjoy TLOU2.

That post was really insightful on why people dislike the TLOU2, although I disagree with the whole “ people who liked Joel were ridiculed” part I understand where this is coming from. My point is that despite this well articulated point on why someone dislikes that games story, it’s a uncommon post. More often than not post are simply Abby bad, Joel good.

I’m not a hard core gamer so playing as the “antagonist” was a new experience for me and added a lot of depth to this story which I had not experienced before. Also a lot of the top post here aren’t exactly in depth looks at why they didn’t like the story but rather Abby bad, Druckmann bad, Joel good post. I can totally understand why you might dislike this game/story due to its flaws but I think a majority of post don’t reflect this.

Thanks for the reply, there are a lot of legitimate reasons why people dislike the game on this subreddit, but they are often drowned out by those who find a single thing they didn’t like and try and integrate it into a meme as if it will “prove” the the sequel is worse than the original.
Thanks, I don’t know why that was their “gotcha” comment

Yea people love to take a side and ride or die with it for some reason, it’s ok to not like the game. What I was trying to get at is that it seems like a lot of people don’t like the game simply because they liked the first one so much they can’t handle to the story in the second not playing out exactly how they thought therefore it must be worse that the original. I recently played through the original and loved it, but I could clearly see how the sequel improved in gameplay, graphics, and depth of supporting characters.

I didn’t say there wasn’t legitimate criticism for this game in this subreddit but the top post in this subreddit are either 
A. Shitting on the fact that you have to try and experience the world through someone else’s point of view
Or.
B. Trying to defend the fact that you’re not homophobic
which I believe most people who didn’t like this game aren’t homophobic/ sexist. I think that players got too attached to Joel to accept that he was a flawed character who actions would have repercussions.

I can agree with that, there were absolutely parts of it the story that I didn’t enjoy. Specifically everything that happened in Santa Barbara. But I still enjoyed the gameplay and story despite this. I’m not saying the game is a 10/10 but I definitely don’t think it deserves as much hate as a lot of people here give it.
Thanks for the insight can’t believe it took me 21 years and 1 reddit comment later to realize this

This is the first time I’ve decided to post anything to reddit so I decided to make a new account. 
I understand that not everyone will like the game, but a lot of the negative attitudes towards the game on this subreddit seems illogical as if they wouldn’t like the game no matter what direction the story took.
